verdict.rationale: First-party docs say C++ gameplay-class changes are reflected in the Unreal Editor after compiling in Visual Studio or Xcode, and that the toolbar lets you quickly test part of the loaded level. That gives a compile-then-preview loop inside the editor, but nothing documents true hot reload or near-instant iteration after a script change. The community note about 24–36 hour builds refers to initial AAA builds, not the iteration loop, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: explicit hot-reload or live-coding documentation, evidence of Blueprint change-to-preview speed, and independent or hands-on confirmation of fast iteration times.
